item.description:
Claude sessions named by their title, a lighter cost indexer, Krea, Japanese brought up to date, and a Windows taskbar strip drawn like the notch.

  • Sessions by title: Claude Code sessions carry their own title instead of the folder name.
  • Lighter on big histories: the cost indexer checks each transcript far more cheaply, and costs react only when a reading changes.
  • Krea ring, a Xiaomi MiMo preset for Custom Endpoints, and one ring per Grok home directory.
  • 日本語 is up to date.
  • Claude plans with only weekly limits read again, remote Claude readings are reused for five minutes, Kiro never sends /usage to the model, Kimi monthly quotas, MiniMax China keys, and deficit rings sort by the soonest expiry.
  • Windows: the taskbar strip and its card drawn as the notch, Claude accounts as rows in the provider list, Antigravity read through agy.exe, and hook events that must carry a local token.
